record.title: Ecuador’s selected land-crossing security closures, December 2025–July 2026 partial reopening
record.scope: Ecuadorian restriction regime closing or limiting authorized land crossings except Rumichaca and Huaquillas; crossing-specific exceptions and reopenings
record.crossings: San Miguel; Macará–La Tina; Lalamor; Jimbura; La Balsa
record.direction: Entry and exit through affected Ecuadorian crossings; Colombian merchandise entry specifically documented in diplomatic record.
record.movement: Ordinary travellers, international buses and freight using affected secondary crossings.
record.exceptions: Rumichaca/Huaquillas remained authorized. San Miguel allowed controlled crude-oil movements and special permits. Macará retained some local work, study and medical access until a July 1 tightening.
record.imposing_authority: Government of Ecuador, border agencies and armed forces
record.enforcement: Military controls and closed migration/customs offices; informal river travel continued near San Miguel.
record.consequences: Loja–Piura bus service suspended; San Miguel users shifted to informal boats; local mobility and commerce affected.
record.relationship: Distinct from 2025 election restrictions AM042/AM049. One national policy family; southern phases are not counted as extra events.
record.status_observation: Status limited to dated evidence; no claim of present closure.
record.official_rationale: National security and control of illicit cross-border activity; southern reopening announcement specifically cites arms trafficking.
record.context: National concentration of formal passage at two gateways; subsequent exemptions and southern relaxation make this a phased restriction regime.
record.uncertainty: July 7 endpoint is Macará’s observed vehicle/pedestrian reopening, not full restoration of all named crossings. July 1 last-closed observation concerns Macará only. Uniform daily implementation at every crossing and the final nationwide endpoint are not established.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. Regime from December 24, 2025 to the July 7, 2026 Macará partial reopening. No all-traffic duration computed.
